statement: The ICE Brent crude front-month futures contract settles at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-10-02. Reference: 96.28 dollars per barrel at packet seal on 2026-09-06 (prior-session close).
resolution: True if the official ICE Brent front-month settlement price for 2026-10-02 is at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel; false if it is below 100.00.
failure_condition: The ICE Brent front-month settlement price for 2026-10-02 is below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield published by the Federal Reserve (FRED series DGS10) for 2026-10-30 is at or above 5.00 percent. Reference: 4.78 percent at packet seal on 2026-09-06 (prior-session close).
resolution: True if the FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-10-30 is 5.00 or greater; false if it is less than 5.00.
failure_condition: The FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-10-30 is below 5.00 percent.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

statement: At the scheduled FOMC meeting concluding 2026-09-16, the Committee raises the federal funds target range above the range in effect at packet seal. Reference: target range 3.50 to 3.75 percent on 2026-09-06 (FRED series DFEDTARU upper limit 3.75).
